summary: In community.dns, the filters option of the hetzner_dns_records and hosttech_dns_records inventory plugins is renamed to simple_filters, and the old name stops working in 2.0.0.
questions: Should I rename filters in my Hetzner DNS inventory config?

answer_card.title: DNS inventory filters renamed
answer_card.answer_md: In the `hetzner_dns_records` and `hosttech_dns_records` inventory plugins, rename `filters` to `simple_filters`. The old name stops working.
